prose: The sedulous loremaster of Symbolic Studies, Mario Garza, returns to Vibe Rant to share some of his ever evolving seasonal researches. Why are classic versions of the Emperor Card in the Tarot depicted as mountains? What does the archaic allegorical archive advise us about the sacred center of our realm and of ourselves? Kings, crosses, rams, and the wisdom of Aries are in the mix for tonight's synchromystic show!
